data.long_meaning: The Old German name Alfreda is derived from the Old High German words alf 'elf' and fraida 'counsel, advice'. It means 'noble, wise advisor'. This name was common in the Middle Ages and was borne by several European monarchs and saints. The name Alfreda carries the meaning “Noble, wise advisor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alfreda usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, wise advisor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
